meta.title: RAGOps Enterprise Copilot
meta.description: Secure AI knowledge platform with document intelligence, tenant isolation and FinOps.

session.expiredBody: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Please sign in again. Unsaved input will be lost.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.subtitle: Sign in with your company account. Tenant and permissions come exclusively from your identity provider.
signin.securityNote: Sign-in uses the authorization code flow with PKCE. Access tokens stay on the server and are never sent to the browser.
signin.claim: Use company knowledge securely – with sources, audit trail and cost control.
signin.claimDetail: Answers with evidence, document intelligence with human review, strict tenant isolation.
signin.signedOutBody: You have been signed out successfully.

idp_unavailable.title: Sign-in service unavailable
idp_unavailable.body: The identity provider is not responding. Please try again in a few minutes.

invalid_state.title: Sign-in interrupted
invalid_state.body: The sign-in attempt expired or is invalid. Please start again.

denied.title: Sign-in denied
denied.body: The identity provider did not confirm the sign-in.

token_rejected.title: Sign-in not possible
token_rejected.body: Your account does not grant valid access to this application. Please contact your administrator.

session_expired.title: Session expired
session_expired.body: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

errors.retryAfter: You can try again in {seconds} seconds.

forbidden.title: Not permitted
forbidden.body: Your role does not allow this action.
forbidden.pageBody: This area is reserved for administrators of your tenant.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.body: The item does not exist or is not visible to your tenant.

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.body: The item was changed in the meantime or the action is not possible in its current state.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.body: The request limit has been reached.

unavailable.title: Service temporarily unavailable
unavailable.body: A dependency is not ready. Please try again later.

api_unreachable.title: API unreachable
api_unreachable.body: The RAGOps service is not responding.

network_error.title: Network error
network_error.body: The request could not be sent. Please check your connection.

csrf_rejected.title: Security check failed
csrf_rejected.body: Please reload the page and try again.

too_large.title: File too large
too_large.body: The request exceeds the permitted size.

contract.title: Unexpected response
contract.body: The service response does not match the expected format and is not displayed.

unknown.title: Unexpected error
unknown.body: Something went wrong. Details are not shown.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The requested page does not exist.

cockpit.title: Enterprise Cockpit
cockpit.description: Operational status for tenant {tenant}. All values come live from the RAGOps API.
cockpit.systemStatusHint: Liveness and readiness of the API and its dependencies.
cockpit.processingHint: {count, plural, =0 {No jobs} one {# job} other {# jobs}} (latest 200).
cockpit.noJobsHint: Upload a synthetic document in the knowledge base.
cockpit.reviewQueueHint: Document intelligence findings that need a human decision.
cockpit.documentsNeedingReview: {count, plural, =0 {No documents} one {# document} other {# documents}} needing review
cockpit.usageScope: Process-wide API counters since the last start – not per tenant.
cockpit.adminOnly: Usage and cost data are visible to administrators only.
cockpit.recentActivityAudit: Latest audit events of your tenant.
cockpit.recentActivityJobs: Latest processing jobs of your tenant.

copilot.title: AI Copilot
copilot.description: Ask questions about your tenant's knowledge base. Answers cite their sources; without sufficient evidence the copilot declines to answer.
copilot.languageNotice: The language switch only affects the user interface. AI answers and source texts are not translated automatically.
copilot.emptyBody: For example: Which deadlines does the reminder letter mention?
copilot.questionHint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. Up to 4000 characters.

validation.tooLong: The question is too long (maximum 4000 characters).

copilot.abstainedBody: The sources found are not sufficient for a reliable answer. The copilot deliberately did not invent one.
copilot.lowEvidenceBody: The answer relies on weak evidence. Please check the sources.
copilot.injectionBody: Possible injected instructions were detected in the sources and ignored.

refusals.forbidden: You are not permitted to make this request. No content was disclosed.
refusals.rate_limited: The request limit has been reached. Please wait briefly and resend the same request.
refusals.budget_exceeded: Your tenant's budget is exhausted. The request was not executed and not charged.
refusals.key_conflict: This request key was already used with a different question. Please ask the question again.
refusals.in_progress: This request is already being processed. Please resend it shortly – it will not be executed twice.
refusals.reconciliation: An earlier execution of this request must first be reconciled by operations. It will not run again.
refusals.no_model: No approved model is available for your tenant. Please contact your administrator.
refusals.egress_denied: Processing by an external AI provider is not authorized for your tenant. No content was sent and nothing was charged.
refusals.not_configured: Cost accounting is not set up for your tenant. Without it, no requests are executed.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Base
knowledge.description: Workspaces, collections, uploads, versions and processing jobs of your tenant.

upload.title: Upload document
upload.description: The document is processed asynchronously (text or OCR extraction, indexing, analysis).
upload.syntheticOnly: Upload synthetic test documents only. Real personal records are not permitted in this environment.
upload.fileHint: PDF, DOCX, Markdown, text, CSV, JPG or PNG. Scans up to 12 MB, text formats up to 2 MB.

errors.title: Please enter a title.
errors.type: This file type is not supported.

jobs.title: Processing jobs
jobs.description: Status refreshes automatically while jobs are running.

details.description: Versions and page report of the text and OCR extraction.
details.noPageReport: No page report is available for this version yet.
details.reviewRequiredBody: At least one page was recognized with low quality. Content from it is not considered verified.

intelligence.title: Document Intelligence
intelligence.description: Deterministically extracted classifications, parties, amounts and deadlines – with source evidence and human review.
intelligence.legalNotice: Amounts shown are statements taken from documents. They are not a legal assessment and do not confirm that a debt is owed or currently outstanding.

documents.caption: Analyzed documents
documents.emptyHint: Analysis results appear here after an upload has been processed.
documents.title: Title

findings.caption: Open review findings
findings.emptyHint: All results are reviewed or need no decision.
findings.subject: Subject

deadlines.caption: Deadlines
deadlines.hint: Dates as stated in the document; they are not legally assessed.

claims.summaryHint: A total is only formed when every claim group is resolved.
claims.consolidated: Sum of the latest stated amounts of all resolved claims
claims.noTotalBody: {count, plural, one {# open item prevents} other {# open items prevent}} a reliable total. Please review the entries.
claims.latestStatedBalance: Latest balance stated in a document (not confirmed)
claims.latestPrincipalOnly: Latest stated principal without a balance (not confirmed)
claims.noLatest: No unambiguous latest stated amount can be determined.

persons.title: Person profiles
persons.hint: Alias values are not shown for privacy reasons, only their count.
persons.createHint: Profiles link documents to an affected person.
persons.label: Label
persons.aliasPrivacy: Aliases are used for matching only and are not shown again after saving.

document.description: Analysis result with source evidence. Corrections are stored next to the original value and logged in a tamper-evident audit trail.
document.readOnlyBody: Review decisions are reserved for the administration and compliance roles.
document.injectionBody: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} with instruction-like content were ignored during analysis.
document.classificationsHint: Candidates with evidence strength; exactly one class can be confirmed.
document.factsHint: Values from the document or derived by rules. Reviewer corrections are marked.
document.noClaimGroups: Not assigned to a claim group

source.title: Source evidence
source.description: Origin of the statement in the original document.
source.highlightLimitBody: The API does not serve the original file, so a page view with highlighting is not available (stored regions: {regions}).

review.title: Review decision
review.auditNotice: Every decision is logged immutably with your identifier, the reason and the version number.
review.amountHint: Non-negative, at most two decimal places, e.g. 1234.50.
review.statusNotCorrectable: Status statements can only be confirmed or rejected.
review.conflictBody: Someone else has already edited this item. The view was reloaded – please check the current state and open the review again.

invalid.amount: Please enter a non-negative amount with at most two decimal places and a three-letter currency.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Operational metrics, dependency readiness and RAG evaluation.

metrics.title: Operational metrics
metrics.hint: Prometheus counters of the API instance (process-wide).
metrics.chartLabel: History since this page was opened

readiness.title: Dependency readiness
readiness.hint: Critical components must be available for the API to accept requests.

evaluation.title: RAG evaluation
evaluation.hint: Latest run of the gold-question evaluation (synthetic).
evaluation.notRun: No evaluation run is available yet.

finops.title: FinOps
finops.description: Cost counters, budgets and simulations of the budget and routing policies.
finops.tenantUsageGapBody: The API endpoints for per-tenant usage, forecast and alerts currently return static placeholders only. They are deliberately not shown here as metrics.

counters.title: Process counters
counters.scope: Since the last start of this API instance, across all tenants. Not a basis for billing.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.volatileNotice: Note: the API currently keeps these budgets in memory only; they are lost on restart.

simulation.title: Budget simulation
simulation.hint: Evaluates a decision with the default hard-limit policy. No cost is incurred.

router.title: Routing simulation
router.hint: Shows which model the router would choose. No model is called.

governance.title: Governance & Operations
governance.description: Audit log, model catalog, model policies and system readiness of your tenant.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: The latest 100 events of your tenant. Question and answer content is not logged.

models.title: Model catalog & providers
models.hint: Approved models and their routing tier.
models.readOnly: Changes to the shared catalog are reserved for platform administration and not possible here.
